## Posts

- [The save that said "done" and wrote nothing](https://hamzaalkoozy1.github.io/posts/the-save-that-said-done-and-wrote-nothing.md): 💸 After an upgrade, a money field stopped saving and threw no error and wrote no log line. The cause was one innocent == that thought 283.28 and 284 were the same number 👇
- [One tiny loop. 64 CPU cores at 100%.](https://hamzaalkoozy1.github.io/posts/one-loop-64-cores.md): 🔥 One tiny loop kept all 64 CPU cores of a production server at 100%. The fix took a few lines: 21 seconds → 0.01. Then I went hunting for its cousins 👇
